messages:
sara: Heads-up — hitting a reproducible mismatch between the sample apps' embed shapes + a duplicate rerank submit when auth refresh happens mid-batch. JS sample (main) returns 1536-d vectors, Python sample sometimes returns 1024-d for same input. Also rerank got duplicate ids after a retry. anyone seen this pattern? :frowning:

sara: repro notes: small batch (2 items) via batching helper, the token expired during request, helper retried the entire batch which caused double-submit to rerank service. python response body occasionally uses the key `vector` instead of `embedding`, and the length is 1024 on those runs.

hiro: Oof. Which SDK versions and sample-app commits? do you have x-request-id and batch ids?

sara: JS SDK 0.22.0, sample-app@main. Python SDK pinned 0.21.3, sample-app@python-experimental. I attached logs with x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d and batch=4521. Logs: 

2026-03-19T09:12:03Z ERROR embed req req_0a1b2c3d 401 expired_token
2026-03-19T09:12:04Z INFO batcher retry batch=4521 attempt=2
2026-03-19T09:12:04Z INFO sending batch=4521 items=2
2026-03-19T09:12:04Z WARN rerank received ids duplicated: ["doc-7"]

alejandra: The key/name inconsistency is concerning. We standardized on `embedding` a while back. rc, any rollout that would alias models to lower-dim variants?

rc: Not intentionally. There was an experiment that exposed a 1024-d family under an alias for perf testing last month; if a model alias gets resolved server-side during a retry path it could return a different underlying model. We should guard the client to validate dims and surface an explicit compatibility error instead of accepting.

sara: Here's the tiny Python snippet used in the sample app: 

```py
from redwood_sdk import Batcher, Embeddings
b = Batcher(max_size=8)
emb = Embeddings()
items = [dict(id='doc-7', text='...'), dict(id='doc-8', text='...')]
res = b.send(items, lambda batch: emb.create(model='rwd-open-embed', inputs=[i['text'] for i in batch]))
```

hiro: Quick workaround: dedupe on the rerank service by unique client batch-id and item id, and validate shapes before scoring. That buys time.

alejandra: From SDK team: created an issue and PR. We'll: (1) change batcher retry to replay only failed requests on auth errors, (2) normalize response keys to `embedding`, and (3) fail-fast when dim != expected. Also will add a `verify_vectors.{py,js}` quickcheck to sample apps.

dev-bot: Issue created: GRW-4890 "batcher: avoid full-batch retries on auth refresh + embedding key/dim parity". PR 5099 opened by @alejandra.

sdk-ci: Added failing unit tests that reproduce 1024 vs 1536 path. Planning patch releases: JS v0.22.2, Python v0.21.6 tomorrow AM.

sara: thanks! will rerun when the patch lands. also consider an onboarding note in the sample-app README to run `verify_vectors` after bootstrapping keys/config — would've saved me ~45 mins.

rc: Agreed. I'll add the onboarding note and an example CI check that runs on PRs for sample apps.

hiro: after patch lands i'll run a few long-tail tests across regions to ensure model alias resolution isn't flipping dims under low-rate retries.

sara: cheers, will post results here.
